prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1362; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened.

A: I was driving home from a shift and had just gotten onto the highway. I was moving over to the right lane to get to my exit.

Q: Can you describe what you saw before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and it looked clear. I put my signal on and started to move over. Then I felt a bump on the side of my car and heard a loud scrape.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point before the impact?

A: Not really. I think it was in my blind spot. I didn't see it until after we touched.

Q: How fast do you think you were going?

A: Maybe around fifty-five. Traffic was moving steadily.

Q: Did you stop after the collision, and did you speak with the other driver?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and we talked briefly. He said he didn't think he could have stopped in time.

Q: Were there any passengers in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening. My left knee was hurting pretty badly and it was swollen.

Q: Can you describe the knee injury and any treatment you have received since?

A: They took X-rays and said there was no fracture, but they think I tore something in the knee. I've been using crutches and I have a follow-up with an orthopedist next week. I've been icing it and taking prescribed pain medication.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
